# BhoomiMitra (भू-मित्र) - Property Marketplace Across India

> BhoomiMitra is an India-focused property marketplace for sale, rent, and lease. Individual, company, and agent sellers can advertise eligible properties, while buyers and tenants can contact the listed seller directly. BhoomiMitra currently charges no platform listing fee and no platform brokerage percentage.

BhoomiMitra supports plots, homes, agricultural land, commercial property, industrial property, and hospitality property. Listing information is seller-provided and may be reviewed by the platform, but BhoomiMitra does not guarantee title, ownership, boundaries, measurements, approvals, encumbrances, or document authenticity. Buyers and tenants should conduct independent due diligence.

Indian Land Measurement Conversions:
- 1 Square Yard = 1 sq. yd (9 sq. ft)
- 1 Gunta = 121 sq. yds
- 1 Cent = 48.4 sq. yds
- 1 Acre = 4,840 sq. yds (40 Guntas / 100 Cents)
- 1 Hectare = 11,959.9 sq. yds (2.471 Acres)

## Key Public Routes

- [Marketplace Homepage](https://bhoomimitra.com/): Property discovery and featured listings.
- [Find Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/buy): Search and filter sale, rent, and lease listings.
- [Post Property](https://bhoomimitra.com/sell): Create a property listing and submit it through the platform workflow.
- [About BhoomiMitra](https://bhoomimitra.com/about): Marketplace model and platform information.
- [Customer Support](https://bhoomimitra.com/contact): Customer support and grievance contact.
- [Listing Rules](https://bhoomimitra.com/listing-rules): Seller requirements, content standards, and prohibited listings.
- [Terms of Service](https://bhoomimitra.com/terms): Platform terms and marketplace responsibilities.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bhoomimitra.com/privacy): Privacy and document-security practices.

## Optional

- [Full Site Specification](https://bhoomimitra.com/llms-full.txt): Extended marketplace, safety, and due-diligence information.
